description: This is a Java class defining the 'Form' entity within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes properties such as form ID, version, build number, publication status, associated encounter type, and form fields. The class provides constructors, getters, setters, and utility methods for managing form fields and represents a core data model within the system.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Represents a form in the OpenMRS system, including metadata, associated fields, and encounter type.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the form.

methods.name: setFormId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the form.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the form.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version string of the form.

methods.name: getBuild
methods.description: Returns the build number of the form.

methods.name: setBuild
methods.description: Sets the build number of the form.

methods.name: getPublished
methods.description: Returns whether the form is published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the form.

methods.name: getEncounterType
methods.description: Returns the encounter type associated with the form.

methods.name: setEncounterType
methods.description: Associates an encounter type with the form.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Returns the set of form fields.

methods.name: getOrderedFormFields
methods.description: Returns the list of form fields ordered by their field number.

methods.name: addFormField
methods.description: Adds a form field to the form.

methods.name: removeFormField
methods.description: Removes a form field from the form.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the form, primarily its ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the form's ID, implementing OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the form's ID, implementing OpenmrsObject interface.
